questions.subject: Social Science
questions.stem: Rohan is listening to two farmers talk about the causes of land degradation. Consider the following statements. 1. Overgrazing is one of the main reasons for land degradation in states like Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra. 2. Over irrigation is responsible for land degradation due to water logging leading to increase in salinity and alkalinity in the soil in the states of Punjab, Haryana and western Uttar Pradesh. Choose the correct option. (A) Both the assertion and the reason are true and the reason is a correct explanation of the assertion. (B) Both the assertion and the reason are true but the reason is not a correct explanation of the assertion. (C) The assertion is true but the reason is false. (D) Both the assertion and the reason are false.

answerScheme.modelAnswer: Both the assertion and the reason are true but the reason is not a correct explanation of the assertion.

questions.stem: Aarav is wondering why the soils of India cannot all be handled as one single kind of soil. Consider the following statements. 1. The soils of India are classified in different types on the basis of the factors responsible for soil formation, colour, thickness, texture and age. 2. India has varied climatic realms and vegetation types, and these have contributed in the development of various types of soils. Choose the correct option. (A) Both the assertion and the reason are true and the reason is a correct explanation of the assertion. (D) Both the assertion and the reason are false.

questions.subject: Social Science
questions.stem: Neha is told that the thin layer of soil on her family's land needed millions of years to form, and she asks whether clearing forests and mining can build more soil quickly. Consider the following statements. 1. It takes millions of years to form soil upto a few cm in depth. 2. Deforestation, over grazing, mining and quarrying are important factors in the formation of soil. Choose the correct option. (A) Both the assertion and the reason are true and the reason is a correct explanation of the assertion. (B) Both the assertion and the reason are true but the reason is not a correct explanation of the assertion. (C) The assertion is true but the reason is false. (D) Both the assertion and the reason are false.
